comments.body: Delivered in records/adam.md at main commit 7bafd23c18cd856a878898ba111d2ff69923f1ea. Search query: Adam optimizer original paper arXiv. Search discovered https://arxiv.org/abs/1412.6980 (and DOI result https://doi.org/10.48550/arxiv.1412.6980); I then opened https://arxiv.org/abs/1412.6980 and read the facts there. Title: Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization. First author: Diederik P. Kingma. Year first appeared: 2014 (v1 submitted 22 December 2014). arXiv identifier: arXiv:1412.6980. Each of these four facts is supported by https://arxiv.org/abs/1412.6980; the record provides field-level links. The abstract identifies the paper as introducing Adam. Use 2014 for first appearance; the page separately lists conference publication in 2015 and last revision in 2017. brief.md preserves the full objective, and the validated assignment.json assigns fact-sheet.md to paper-repo following the supplied split.

issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
Optimizer provenance fact sheet (a small look-up task).

Produce a one-page fact sheet on three optimizers used in deep learning: Adam, AdamW (decoupled weight decay) and Lion (EvoLved Sign Momentum). For each optimizer give the paper that introduced it: its title, its first author, the year it first appeared, and its arXiv identifier.

Every fact must be looked up on the web during this task, not given from memory, and each fact must cite the URL of the page it was read from. Find each paper with a web search first (do not start from a URL you already know), then open the page the search found to read the facts. If your environment has no web search tool, say so in your record and find the page another way the environment offers.

Division of work: experiment-repo looks up Adam and records what it found, with its search query and URLs, in its repository; paper-repo looks up AdamW, collects the three entries and writes the fact sheet (`fact-sheet.md`) as the delivery; internal-review-repo independently looks up Lion and checks each entry of the fact sheet against a source it opens itself, reporting any disagreement before it approves.
issue.title: Research objective

comments.author: internal-review-repo
comments.body:
Independent Lion lookup, done during this task per the objective (web search first, then opened the page the search found). Full record pushed in lion-lookup.md at commit 7daad232bafdab3c7c23306868e433b71ee6c8b0.

Search:
- Tool: this environment's web search (OpenCode websearch through Exa)
- Query: Lion optimizer "EvoLved Sign Momentum" paper arXiv
- The search returned the arXiv page of the paper that introduced Lion.

Page opened and read (2026-10-17): https://arxiv.org/abs/2302.06675 (arXiv abstract page; its abstract states the paper discovers a simple and effective optimization algorithm, Lion (EvoLved Sign Momentum)).

Facts for the Lion row, each read from that page:
- Title: Symbolic Discovery of Optimization Algorithms — source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2302.06675
- First author: Xiangning Chen — source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2302.06675
- Year first appeared: 2023 (v1 submitted 13 Feb 2023 per the page's submission history) — source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2302.06675
- arXiv identifier: arXiv:2302.06675 — source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2302.06675

Once fact-sheet.md is delivered I will check every entry against sources I open myself, as the objective requires, and report any disagreement before approving.
